r0.why: Manual Euclidean division with less writing [1], Ruffini's rule for monic linear, generalizable [2], x - a form [5].

r1.why: No variables, few calculations, less space [3]; sign switch turns subtractions into additions, preventing sign errors [4].

r2.why: Numerator [6], drop and multiply steps [7],[8], remainder -123 and quotient coefficient order [9],[10].

r3.why: Remainder theorem use [11],[12], just over half the multiplications [13], Horner's method [14].

r4.why: Coefficients only, top row, diagonal with sign change, drop/multiply/repeat, degree-one remainder all from [15]-[22].

r5.why: No pre-reduction [27], divide after dropping before multiplying [28], extra row and unchanged sign [29],[30].
